Name: dotnet CLI
OneLiner: The command-line tool to create, build, test, run and publish .NET projects.

Name: Visual Studio
OneLiner: Full-featured Windows IDE with the best debugger and profiling tools for .NET.
NotIdealFor: Quick edits on a low-power machine
TokenTips: Use the Diagnostic Tools window to spot memory growth
Enable analyzers to catch issues while typing

Name: JetBrains Rider
OneLiner: Cross-platform .NET IDE with strong refactoring and code analysis.
TokenTips: Use the dotTrace integration for performance work

Name: xUnit
OneLiner: The most widely used unit-testing framework for .NET.
TokenTips: Use `WebApplicationFactory` for end-to-end ASP.NET Core tests
Keep tests independent so they can run in parallel

Name: BenchmarkDotNet
OneLiner: Reliable micro-benchmarking: measures time and allocations of small pieces of code.
TokenTips: Look at allocations, not only time

Name: Serilog
OneLiner: Structured logging with many sinks (files, Seq, Elasticsearch, console).
BestFor: Shipping logs to a central system
